card.name: Digits 7-9 right after a separator
card.fires_on: A single digit 7, 8 or 9 that comes right after a dot or hyphen in a number. It appears in phone numbers, section numbers like 8.7 or 14.9, and version or size figures.

modes.label: Phone number digits
modes.description: The digit 8 or 9 right after a hyphen in a phone or fax number.

modes.label: Section and decimal numbers
modes.description: The digit 7, 8 or 9 after a dot in a section cross-reference or a decimal figure.

card.plain: It marks a high digit (7, 8 or 9) that follows a dot or hyphen in phone numbers and section numbers.
